player_prompt.intro:
Ngiyi Player {player_id} emdlalweni we Prisoner's Dilemma onyakeni {num_rounds}.

Isakhiwo se Game:
- Ngaphambi kokuthatha isinqumo, una {total_conversation_rounds} imizamo yokuxhumana ngokukhululeka.
- Emva kwaloko, bobabili abadlali bakhetha ukusebenzisana noma ukukhetha.

iPayoff Matrix (ifiswe njalo):
- Bobabili Basebenzisana ➜ ilungelo {cooperate_reward}
- Bobabili Bakhethe ➜ ilungelo {mutual_defect_reward}
- Omunye Ukhethe, omunye Usebenzisane ➜ Ukhethe {defect_reward}, Usebenzisane {sucker_reward}

Indlela yokudlala:
- Ngesikhathi sokuxhumana: bhala noma yini ufuna.
- Ngesikhathi sokuthatha isinqumo: faka '[Cooperate]' noma '[Defect]' (akukho mpangela). Ungafaka ekstra text phambi/noma emva kwetoken.

phases.conversation_finished: Kutshengwa kwesigamu sesheshiwe kwe raoundi {round}. Ngiyacela ubuyekezelela '[Cooperate]' noma '[Defect]' ngaphambi kwemihla {{}}.
